The input image is ONLY a reference for bright hand-painted children's fantasy style, warm cream ivory / pale honey stone palette, natural soft edges, overhead 3/4 near-isometric camera, and small irregular paving-stone scale. Match those aspects, invent the entire composition anew. Setting: colorful insect civilization of amber resin, translucent shells, fresh huge leaves, pollen flowers, rounded honeywax architecture. It is a sunny open valley, friendly, rich, luminous, no gloom.
CRITICAL game geometry: image coordinates use normalized x/y. The central playable hard dry floor must remain a single flat continuous clear dry stone surface throughout the polygon [(0.25,0.18),(0.45,0.105),(0.67,0.12),(0.82,0.19),(0.885,0.30),(0.90,0.60),(0.86,0.76),(0.71,0.87),(0.50,0.93),(0.30,0.87),(0.165,0.74),(0.12,0.56),(0.14,0.36),(0.205,0.24)]. No drawn objective, chest, enemy, person, creature, egg monster, HUD, UI, map icon, text, letter or watermark anywhere. Tiny flat moss seams and subtle color variations in paving are allowed. All outer scenery naturally supports the floor with roots and softly layered sloping banks. No rectangular floating slab, giant wall or rigid symmetric frame. Complete filled background right to every image edge, with distinctive outer ecological and architectural scene. ROOM ID: BO02.

Far northmost center ABOVE y=0.105 only: a tall distant rounded honeywax hive-palace flanked by giant four-petal ivory-lilac crown canopy and translucent amber window cells. Palace sits back behind floor edge and its feet never overlap playable polygon. Extreme top-left and top-right corners giant leaves cradle the distant crown architecture, leaving a clear dry stone corridor toward north. Extreme bottom corners have low petal terraces, leaf-root slopes and white/lilac flowers. Middle-bottom y>0.93 dry leaf-root entry ramp emerges into open stone courtyard. Composition formal broad royal panorama with four-petal crown skyline, more ceremonial than other rooms, but avoid symmetric rigid square frame. Entire central combat ground is plain clear warm ivory small-stone surface, subtle broad pale floral inlay flush with ground allowed, no center dais, throne, objects or holes.
